title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Milton III returns to Cowboys on practice squad
items.desc: The Cowboys signed QB Joe Milton to their practice squad.
items.impact: Milton cleared waivers after he was let go by Dallas. He will return to a depth role in its quarterback room.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (hand) gets in limited practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (hand) got in a limited practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: Meyers is "all good," according to head coach Liam Coen. The veteran receiver has been practicing in a limited capacity this week and is not a concern for Week 1.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) practicing in full
items.desc: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) has been practicing in full this week.
items.impact: Thomas has been limited by a shoulder injury recently, but he was back to full practice activity on Tuesday. The third-year wideout should be good to go for Week 1.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonathon Brooks 'optimistic' for Week 1
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said he is "very optimistic" Jonathon Brooks will play in Week 1 against the Bears.
items.impact: Brooks was absent from practice on Tuesday as he deals with some soreness. His status will need to be monitored in practice next week heading into the season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Isaiah Bond (concussion) misses practice
items.desc: Isaiah Bond did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bond had reportedly cleared concussion protocol, so it is unclear what happened. His status for Week 1 is up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Evans (adductor) returns to practice
items.desc: Mike Evans returned to practice Wednesday.
items.impact: Evans was back on the field after being sidelined for most of training camp. He should be good to go for the season opener next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Khalil Shakir (undisclosed) 'optimistic' for Week 1
items.desc: There's "currently optimism" from the Bills that Khalil Shakir will play in Week 1 against the Texans.
items.impact: Shakir has been sidelined from practice for the past couple of weeks due to an undisclosed injury. Buffalo is reportedly being cautious with him.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chuma Edoga signs with Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens signed Chuma Edoga.
items.impact: Edoga appeared in 14 games for the Jaguars last year. He will add depth for Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joshua Karty works out for Jets
items.desc: The Jets hosted free agent kicker Joshua Karty for a workout.
items.impact: Karty was one of three kickers to workout for the Jets. They continue to address the position after recently claiming Blake Grupe off waivers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Badgley works out for Jets
items.desc: The Jets hosted free agent kicker Michael Badgley for a workout.
items.impact: Badgley was one of three kickers to workout for the Jets. They continue to address the position after recently claiming Blake Grupe off waivers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Justin Tucker works out for Jets
items.desc: The Jets hosted free agent kicker Justin Tucker for a workout.
items.impact: Tucker was one of three kickers to workout for the Jets. They continue to address the position after recently claiming Blake Grupe off waivers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alvin Kamara (knee) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Alvin Kamara remained absent from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kamara remains uncertain for the start of the season next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kendre Miller not seen at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kendre Miller was not seen practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Miller departed practice early on Tuesday. There will be an update on his injury status when available.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee) says he expects to play Week 1
items.desc: Nick Bosa told reporters he expects to play in the season opener next week against the Rams.
items.impact: Bosa reportedly had a strong practice on Wednesday. It is unclear if he will be on any sort of snap count in his first game back.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Kirk Cousins named Raiders Week 1 starter
items.desc: Kirk Cousins has been named the Raiders Week 1 starter against the Dolphins.
items.impact: It's long been presumed that the Raiders would start Cousins and give Mendoza at least a half-redshirt year. This just confirms it. He could be an interesting streaming option, but we need to see more from the pass catchers not named Brock Bowers to really feel confident in this passing offense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kedon Slovis signs with Packers practice squad
items.desc: The Packers signed QB Kedon Slovis to their practice squad.
items.impact: Slovis was waived by the Cardinals. He will add depth in the quarterback room for Green Bay.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Robert Longerbeam signs with Eagles
items.desc: The Eagles signed CB Robert Longerbeam.
items.impact: Longerbeam was previously with the Ravens. He was waived.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jamie Sheriff signs with Rams
items.desc: The Rams signed LB Jamie Sheriff to their practice squad.
items.impact: Sheriff was previously with the Seahawks. He was waived on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Shemar Bartholomew signs with Titans
items.desc: The Titans signed CB Shemar Bartholomew to their practice squad.
items.impact: Bartholomew will add depth in the secondary for Tennessee heading into the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mario Goodrich III released by Titans
items.desc: The Titans released Mario Goodrich III.
items.impact: Goodrich will seek another opportunity heading into the season.
